content: React 19 state management for multi-step flow (4 steps: CV input -> Lebenslauf -> questions -> streamed letter): useReducer is the right choice over useState for this flow. Rationale: (1) 4-step flow has interdependent transitions — currentStep, cvText, lebenslauf result, answers[], streamedText, isStreaming — managing these as independent useState calls creates race conditions on step transitions; (2) useReducer provides atomic state transitions (dispatch({ type: 'PARSE_DONE', lebenslauf }) sets both the result and advances the step atomically); (3) no context needed — all state lives in one top-level Client Component (the page), passed as props to step sub-components; (4) no Zustand needed — Zustand adds value when state is shared across unrelated subtrees or persisted; this app has one linear flow in one page. Anti-pattern to avoid: useContext for this flow — unnecessary complexity for a single-page liner app.
